sources.title: Trundle Build Guide: 🔸Trundle / Get a Closer Look🔸

passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.text: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

spells.name: Chomp
spells.text: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.

spells.name: Frozen Domain
spells.text: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.

spells.name: Pillar of Ice
spells.text: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

spells.name: Subjugate
spells.text: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

archetype.value: Trundle is an objective-control jungler who uses dueling power and map pressure to carry.

winCondition.value: Trundle wins by turning small advantages into objectives, towers, and the Nexus.

spikes.why: Trundle can steal Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance immediately, then double the stolen amounts over four seconds.

bait.why: After Trundle uses Chomp, enemies have a 3.5-second window before he can bite and sap Attack Damage again.
After Trundle uses Frozen Domain, its 18–14-second cooldown gives enemies a window before he can create another domain.
After Trundle uses Pillar of Ice, its 21–15-second cooldown gives enemies a window without a new pillar or its nearby slow.

mistakes.value: Trundle becomes easier to punish when he pushes forward without respecting his limits.
Trundle players make mistakes when they force invades or fights without respecting the champion’s limits.
Trundle loses Frozen Domain’s bonuses when he fights outside it.
